lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is regarding an official inquiry. Your identity has been found in records connected to illegal fund movement.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am the investigating officer assigned to your file.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: For your own protection, keep this conversation between us until the matter is closed. Your relatives might be questioned otherwise.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There is very little time. If the file goes to the magistrate tonight you will be taken into custody.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The only way to close the file is to place your balance with the department temporarily. It comes back once you are cleared.
